description: Configure state, railroad, county, crossing-type, status, and recency filters to extract US railroad grade crossing inventory records from the FRA's official open data.

states.description: US state names to include (e.g. ["Texas", "Ohio"]). Matched case-insensitively against the published state name. Empty means all states.
states.title: States (Optional)

railroadCode.description: Optional railroad reporting mark / code, exactly as published (e.g. "BNSF", "UP", "CSX").
railroadCode.title: Railroad Code (Optional)

county.description: Optional county name keyword, matched case-insensitively as a substring (e.g. "Harris").
county.title: County Keyword (Optional)

crossingType.description: Filter by crossing ownership type as published by the FRA.
crossingType.title: Crossing Type

activeOnly.description: When true, only crossings not marked closed in the inventory are returned.
activeOnly.title: Active Crossings Only

updatedWithinDays.description: Only crossings whose inventory record was revised within the last N days. 0 means no recency filter.
updatedWithinDays.title: Updated Within Days (0 = Any)

minTrainsPerDay.description: Only crossings whose total trains per day (through + switching + transit, day + night) is at least this value.
minTrainsPerDay.title: Minimum Trains Per Day

maxItems.description: Maximum number of crossing records to extract.
maxItems.title: Max Crossings

title: US Railroad Grade Crossing Inventory Input
